rules.grid: one value for every 1 m cell, in rows from minZ, each row from minX, run-length packed as (value, count) pairs: 0 not land to build on, 1 the start area, n + 1 section n
rules.open: a section can be opened when one of the sections in its nextTo list is open; 0 in that list is the start area
rules.closed: until a section is opened its cells cannot be built on or walked on, and its wild growth and its sign are drawn
rules.paths: the island's own paths, the great tree's terrace, the pier and the beach are in no section: they are open from the first day
rules.ring: how many sections lie between a section and the start area; a fair price rises with it
